name: Lady Astrea
source: A female executive of Millennium who concurs with the organization's vision of "creating a new world." She is a brawling type and recognizes Makina as her lifelong rival. Her previous base was destroyed and what will become of her? She is a virtuous warrior, but she has a past of being trained as a slave.
